room_rent.note: No room rent restriction; proportionate deduction not applicable for room

copayment.display: None (Zone A payers); 20% if Zone B payer treats in Zone A
copayment.note: Zone-wise co-pay: Zone B premium payers bear 20% co-pay for treatment in Zone A. No mandatory age-based co-pay. Voluntary co-pay optional add-on available.

sub_limits.display: Vision correction ₹1L; Maternity sub-limited (if opted); OPD prenatal/postnatal ₹10k
sub_limits.note: Modern treatment up to 100% BSI; most covers within SI. Maternity is optional add-on.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible available as optional add-on (₹10k–₹1L)

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 24 or 12 mo via optional add-on)
ped_waiting.note: Optional Benefit 3.7.6 can reduce to 24 or 12 months for additional premium

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye conditions and listed surgeries

maternity.display: Optional add-on; 24mo wait (1-2yr policy); 0/12/24mo wait (3yr+ policy)
maternity.note: Limit: ₹1L or ₹2L (option) for SI ≥10L; covers normal & C-section, max 2 deliveries; includes newborn & infertility cover within maternity limit

cumulative_bonus.note: Reduces by 33.33% in claim year. Optional Guaranteed CB (Option A) prevents reduction; Option B gives 100%/yr up to 300% of BSI.

restoration.note: Reinstated BSI available unlimited times for both related and unrelated illness/injury after exhaustion of BSI + Extra SI + Cumulative Bonus

pre_hosp.note: Extendable to 90 days via optional Convenience Cover add-on

post_hosp.note: Extendable to 180 days via optional Convenience Cover add-on

domiciliary.note: Min 3 continuous days; excludes asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy and several other listed conditions

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under main hospitalisation benefit

organ_donor.note: Includes donor's pre and post hospitalisation expenses

ambulance.note: Air ambulance available as optional add-on (7.5% of BSI or ₹5L whichever higher)

modern_treatments.note: Includes robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy, oral chemo, etc.

consumables.note: List I, II, III, IV items covered if optional Benefit 3.7.3.2 opted; otherwise List I excluded

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only; overseas treatment excluded

grace_period.display: 30 days (15 days for monthly premium mode)

notable_exclusions: Overseas treatment, sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hearing aids/spectacles, external durable equipment, OPD treatment, alcoholic cirrhosis (permanent)
optional_riders: Short Stay Treatment, Chronic Shield, Guaranteed CB (A/B), Consumables Cover, Double Cover, Change Room Rent, Reduce PED wait, Voluntary Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Hospital Cash, Air Ambulance, Convalescence, Vision Correction, Maternity+Newborn+Infertility, Home Care, Companion Cover, Child Care Cover
